process_chat_payload: process a chat payload through pipeline filters, tools, memory, web search, and file retrieval handlers
process_chat_response: process a streaming or non-streaming chat response with real-time event emission and background task handling
get_citation_source_from_tool_result: parse a tool result string and convert it into structured source dicts for citation display

apply_source_context_to_messages: build source context from citation sources and inject it into chat messages using RAG template
